column1: # PleaseBeReady buyer audit, Nov 19 2026. Journeys: home-12 (homepage Essentials), food-water-4x7 (4 people, 7 days), camping-* (Weekend camping kit, 4 people 3 days), party-* (Birthday party kit, 20 people 12 kids).

# Method: Amazon blocks AI agents from its pages, so each listing was checked by ASIN with a web search limited to amazon.com (cached snapshots: undated, not location-aware). result: purchasable = the snapshot shows an offer (price, buy box, In Stock or Add to cart); unknown = listing live and matching, no stock or offer text either way; unavailable = "Currently unavailable" or "No featured offers available"; wrong-variant = only a used offer, or the listing disagrees with the variant or size we name; not-found = no listing found by ASIN or by name; search = a tagged search link (not a stock check). No prices or ratings are kept.
